text: Nothing here moves. Just twelve drawings of a bird, and twelve slits.
Spin the disc, and look through the slits at a mirror.
Each slit shows one drawing for an instant. The eye keeps it, until the next arrives.
At the right speed, the bird flies.
Spin it backwards, and the bird flies backwards.
Now the camera looks as well, twenty-four times a second. The wheel creeps backwards, and the birds fly on.
Unroll the ring, bend it into a drum, and a gentleman walks forever.
Every moving picture works this way. Still drawings, shown fast.
Now stop the wheel, and it is only a drawing again.
Nothing moves. We only look quickly.
